# apim_authz_pdp (Resource)

A PDP gateway: the authorization engine of a `target_pdp_id`, run on the gateways of a sharding `tag`, with its AuthZEN endpoint. APIM refuses with a `409` the delete of a PDP gateway that is the only target of an entity or a policy, and deletes nothing; the untagged `default` PDP gateway can always be deleted. Requires APIM 4.14 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apim_authz_pdp" "orders_eu" {
  hrid          = "orders-eu"
  name          = "Orders PDP (EU)"
  target_pdp_id = "orders"
  tag           = "eu"
  endpoint = {
    path = "/authz/orders-eu"
  }
}

# Schemas, entities and policies name the PDP gateway by its routing scope,
# here orders@eu.
output "orders_eu_routing_scope" {
  value = apim_authz_pdp.orders_eu.routing_scope
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hrid` (String) A unique human readable id identifying this resource. Requires replacement if changed.
- `name` (String) Display name of the PDP gateway; converges on re-apply
- `target_pdp_id` (String) The PDP engine the gateway runs. Every PDP gateway of one targetPdpId shares the engine, and its `strict`
value.

### Optional

- `endpoint` (Attributes) The AuthZEN endpoint of the PDP: an API that listens on `path` and on the matching AuthZEN discovery path. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoint))
- `environment_id` (String) environment ID
- `organization_id` (String) organization ID
- `strict` (Boolean) Whether the engine checks policies and entities against its schema. Shared by every PDP of the
targetPdpId: on create it has to agree with the registered ones, and a change on an existing PDP
changes them all, with a warning naming each.
Default: false
- `tag` (String) An APIM sharding tag key, which selects the gateway nodes that run the PDP.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource UUID
- `routing_scope` (String) `targetPdpId@tag`, or `targetPdpId` untagged: what the targets of other resources name
- `well_known_path` (String) The AuthZEN discovery path of the endpoint. Absent without an endpoint, or when another API already
held that path when the endpoint was created.

<a id="nestedatt--endpoint"></a>
### Nested Schema for `endpoint`

Required:

- `path` (String) Context path of the endpoint, unique among the APIs of the environment, and outside
`/.well-known/authzen-configuration`. Written the way APIM stores it, without the trailing slash,
so the state reads it back as declared: `/authz/orders-eu`, not `authz//orders-eu/`. A changed
path replaces the endpoint.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apim_authz_pdp.orders_eu
  id = jsonencode({
    environment_id  = "DEFAULT"
    hrid            = "orders-eu"
    organization_id = "DEFAULT"
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apim_authz_pdp.orders_eu '{"environment_id": "DEFAULT", "hrid": "orders-eu", "organization_id": "DEFAULT"}'
```
